newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields fall on Bulgaria 1-,4-wk discount T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall on Bulgaria 1-,4-wk discount T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell at Monday's auctions of Bulgaria's finance ministry one-week and four-week discount T-bills, the central bank said.
The average yields to maturity on the two issues were 1.20 and 5.19 percent, respectively, down from 1.30 and 5.24 percent at Friday's auctions.
Bids were received for a total of 75.340 billion lev worth of T-bills for today's auctions but the ministry approved bids for 44.131 billion levs of paper.
The issues were offered with par values of 12 billion levs and 45 billion levs, respectively, and no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 12,000 million levs 45,000 million levs
Bids received 43,205.7 million levs 32,134.5 million levs
Bids approved 12,000 million levs 32,130.5 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 1.20 pct 5.19 pct
